$comment: DESIGN-LED, deliberately. This catalog exists to reproduce the published M3 Wear OS Apps Design Kit, so the kit is authoritative and a divergence is a bug in this code — the opposite of the `wear-m3` component-system catalog in compose-ai-tools, whose own render is the source of truth. Direction also has teeth beyond reporting: design-parity's Code-to-Canvas push-back is gated on `code-led`, so `design-led` makes writing back to the Figma file structurally impossible rather than merely forbidden by convention.
